name: cv-compact
description: Serves a session's compaction from cv's ready summary inside Claude Code's own compaction, falls back to Claude Code's on every miss, and records every compaction for comparison.

serve.title: Which compaction serves this seat
serve.description: host: cv's [precompact] serve setting decides; native: Claude Code's own (cv only records); cv: cv's ready summary when its commit check passes, Claude Code's own on every miss.

cv.title: The cv binary
cv.description: The cv executable the hook runs (a path, or a name on PATH).

deadline_ms.title: Commit deadline (ms)
deadline_ms.description: How long the commit may take before Claude Code compacts as its own.
